## Line 119

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 119](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L119).

```plato

    // The area-weighted centroid of the boundary minus the holes: each hole
    // contributes its centroid with a NEGATIVE weight.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centroid#By_geometric_decomposition
    // Precondition: the net area is non-zero.
    Centroid(r: PolygonWithHoles2D): Point2D
    {
        var boundaryArea = r.Boundary.Area;
        var holeAreas = r.Holes.Map(h => h.Area);
        var net = boundaryArea - SumOf(holeAreas);
        var centre = r.Boundary.Centroid;
        var cx = centre.X * boundaryArea
            - SumOf(r.Holes.Count.MapRange(i => r.Holes[i].Centroid.X * holeAreas[i]));
        var cy = centre.Y * boundaryArea
            - SumOf(r.Holes.Count.MapRange(i => r.Holes[i].Centroid.Y * holeAreas[i]));
        return (cx / net, cy / net);
    }
```

```plato
    // The base centroid displaced by half the sweep: the prism is uniform along
    // Offset.
    Centroid(p: Prism3D): Point3D
        => p.Base.Centroid + p.Offset * 0.5;
```

## Line 443

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 443](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L443).

```plato

    // One quarter of the way from the base centroid towards the Apex: the standard
    // centroid of any solid cone over a planar base.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pyramid_(geometry)
    Centroid(y: Pyramid3D): Point3D
        => y.Base.Centroid + y.Base.Centroid.Between(y.Apex) * 0.25;
```
